mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id AS id , p.place_name AS name , p.address AS address , p.road_address AS roadAddress , p.category AS category , p.phone AS phone , CASE WHEN #{userEmail} IS NOT NULL AND pl.useremail IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS liked , 0 AS distanceM , pi.id AS imageId , pi.original_file_name AS originalFileName , pi.stored_file_name AS storedFileName , pi.file_path AS filePath , pi.file_size AS fileSize , pi.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM place p LEFT JOIN place_like pl ON pl.place_id = p.place_id AND pl.useremail = #{userEmail} LEFT JOIN place_image pi ON pi.place_id = p.place_id AND pl.useremail = #{userEmail} WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}
